close_reason: MTA-STS policy parser implemented; check+clippy clean
description: Implement parse_mta_sts_policy(body: &str) -> Result<MtaStsPolicy, MtaStsError>. Parses the line-based key:value format (RFC 8461 §3.2). Rules: version:STSv1 must appear first, mode must be none/testing/enforce, at least one mx line required, max_age must be 0..=31557600 (1 year in seconds), unknown keys are silently ignored per spec. Body must not exceed max_policy_body_bytes (64 KiB default). Return MtaStsError::PolicyParseFailed with field path on violation. MtaStsPolicy struct: version, mode, mx_patterns: Vec<String>, max_age: u32.
title: MTA-STS policy file parser
